## [Version: v2.0.0-alpha.9] - 2026-11-19

Full Changelog: [v2.0.0-alpha.8...v2.0.0-alpha.9](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/compare/v2.0.0-alpha.8...v2.0.0-alpha.9)

**发布范围**

- ACP 2.0 Alpha 维护更新，改善模型上下文窗口未知时的目录恢复、诊断和 fallback 提示。

**缺陷修复**

- 修复模型目录补载仅尝试一次的问题：目录未命中时，后续请求可重新加载；并发请求共享进行中的加载，每次完成后冷却 30 秒，避免未知模型每轮都触发目录请求。
- 补充目录加载诊断，区分 API 不可用、响应结构错误、请求失败、空目录和无有效上下文窗口；记录条目数量，不记录原始响应或异常正文。
- 修正未知窗口告警，准确区分使用 `compress.contextLimitFallback` 与禁用 fallback，不再错误声称默认 fallback 下所有相关检查均已禁用。
- 补充 fallback 配置与预算风险说明，修正缺陷报告模板中的 OpenCode V2 支持范围。

**兼容性与升级前置条件**

- 要求 **OpenCode >=2.1.4 且 <3**。
- 不增加配置项或依赖，不改变持久化状态格式；从 alpha.8 升级无需数据迁移。
- `compress.contextLimitFallback` 默认仍为 `128000`，设为 `0` 可禁用。恢复真实模型窗口后，相关阈值会改按该窗口计算。

**已知问题**

- 本版不包含摘要引用保真门禁的调整，不保证解决 [#60](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/issues/60) 中所有压缩后重复取证现象。
- fallback 不会扩大模型真实容量；自定义模型应优先正确配置 OpenCode 的 `limit.context`。

---

## [Version: v2.0.0-alpha.9] - 2026-11-19

Full Changelog: [v2.0.0-alpha.8...v2.0.0-alpha.9](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/compare/v2.0.0-alpha.8...v2.0.0-alpha.9)

**Release scope**

- An ACP 2.0 Alpha maintenance update improving catalog recovery, diagnostics, and fallback warnings when the model context window is unknown.

**Fixes**

- Fix catalog hydration being attempted only once on a miss. Later requests can retry; concurrent requests share an in-flight load, with a 30-second cooldown after completion to avoid catalog requests on every turn for unknown models.
- Add catalog diagnostics distinguishing unavailable APIs, malformed responses, request failures, empty catalogs, and entries without valid context limits. Log entry counts without raw responses or exception text.
- Correct missing-window warnings to distinguish an active `compress.contextLimitFallback` from a disabled fallback, rather than incorrectly claiming that all related checks are disabled with the default fallback.
- Document fallback configuration and budget risks, and correct the bug report template’s OpenCode V2 compatibility statement.

**Compatibility and upgrade prerequisites**

- Requires **OpenCode >=2.1.4 and <3**.
- No new configuration options or dependencies, and no changes to persisted state formats. Upgrading from alpha.8 requires no data migration.
- `compress.contextLimitFallback` still defaults to `128000`; set it to `0` to disable it. Once the actual model window is recovered, related thresholds use that window.

**Known issues**

- This release does not change summary citation-fidelity gates or guarantee resolution of every repeated evidence-retrieval loop reported in [#60](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/issues/60).
- A fallback does not increase the model’s actual capacity. Custom models should have an accurate OpenCode `limit.context` configuration.

## [Version: v2.0.0-alpha.8] - 2026-11-19

Full Changelog: [v2.0.0-alpha.7...v2.0.0-alpha.8](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/compare/v2.0.0-alpha.7...v2.0.0-alpha.8)

**发布范围**

- ACP 2.0 Alpha 维护更新，修复后台 agent handoff 在 V2 模型请求中被静默丢弃的问题。

**缺陷修复**

- 保留当前请求已交付的后台 agent 结果及其消息标识和 metadata，支持仅包含 handoff、没有人工 prompt 的请求。
- 区分 handoff 与人工 prompt，避免错误应用用户消息保护；压缩后不再重新带回 handoff 原文，持久化重启后仍可解压恢复。
- 防止运行中晚到、模型尚未看到的 handoff 被提前纳入压缩。
- 保留已有 message refs，按实际消息顺序规划压缩范围；历史引用无法可靠恢复时保留原始历史，避免错误裁剪。

**兼容性与升级前置条件**

- 要求 **OpenCode >=2.1.4 且 <3**。
- 不增加配置项或依赖，不改变持久化状态格式或 compression block IDs；从 alpha.7 升级无需数据迁移。
- 新压缩结果包含内部引用语义标记；缺少可靠历史引用时，部分历史会保持未压缩状态。

**已知问题**

- 本版不包含 [#51](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/issues/51) 中的图片/base64、解压预算或其他性能问题修复，也不代表所有后台 agent 唤醒问题均已解决。

---

## [Version: v2.0.0-alpha.8] - 2026-11-19

Full Changelog: [v2.0.0-alpha.7...v2.0.0-alpha.8](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/compare/v2.0.0-alpha.7...v2.0.0-alpha.8)

**Release scope**

- An ACP 2.0 Alpha maintenance update fixing background-agent handoffs silently dropped from V2 model requests.

**Fixes**

- Preserve background-agent results already delivered to the current request, including message identity and metadata. Support handoff-only requests without a human prompt.
- Distinguish handoffs from human prompts to avoid incorrect user-message protection. Compressed handoff payloads no longer reappear, and decompression remains available after a persisted restart.
- Prevent late-arriving handoffs that the model has not seen from being compressed prematurely.
- Preserve existing message refs and plan compression ranges in transcript order. Retain raw history when historical references cannot be recovered reliably, avoiding incorrect pruning.

**Compatibility and upgrade prerequisites**

- Requires **OpenCode >=2.1.4 and <3**.
- No new configuration options or dependencies, and no changes to persisted state formats or compression block IDs. Upgrading from alpha.7 requires no data migration.
- New compression results include an internal reference-semantics marker. Some history remains uncompressed when reliable historical references are unavailable.

**Known issues**

- This release does not include fixes for image/base64 handling, decompression budgets, or other performance issues tracked in [#51](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/issues/51), and does not resolve every background-agent wake-up issue.

## [Version: v2.0.0-alpha.7] - 2026-11-17

Full Changelog: [v2.0.0-alpha.6...v2.0.0-alpha.7](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/compare/v2.0.0-alpha.6...v2.0.0-alpha.7)

**发布范围**

- ACP 2.0 Alpha 维护更新，修复 V2 模型上下文上限的读取与使用。

**缺陷修复**

- 修复模型目录响应解析错误，避免目录中已有上下文上限的模型仍使用 fallback。
- system prompt 阶段按当前 provider/model 读取同一模型目录中的上限，不再固定传入零值。
- 依赖上下文上限的百分比阈值按当前模型目录值计算；未知模型继续沿用既有 fallback 行为。

**兼容性与升级前置条件**

- 要求 **OpenCode >=2.1.4 且 <3**。
- 不改变配置、持久化状态格式、message refs 或 compression block IDs；从 alpha.6 升级无需进行这些数据的迁移。

**已知问题**

- 本修复不保证本地 token 估算等同于 provider 的实际请求预算，也不代表 [#51](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/issues/51) 中的性能及图片压缩问题已全部解决。

---

## [Version: v2.0.0-alpha.7] - 2026-11-17

Full Changelog: [v2.0.0-alpha.6...v2.0.0-alpha.7](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/compare/v2.0.0-alpha.6...v2.0.0-alpha.7)

**Release scope**

- An ACP 2.0 Alpha maintenance update fixing how V2 model context limits are loaded and used.

**Fixes**

- Fix model catalog response parsing so models with a catalog-provided context limit no longer incorrectly use the fallback.
- Resolve the context limit for the current provider/model from the same catalog during system prompt processing instead of always passing zero.
- Percentage-based thresholds use the current model's catalog limit. Unknown models retain the existing fallback behavior.

**Compatibility and upgrade prerequisites**

- Requires **OpenCode >=2.1.4 and <3**.
- No changes to configuration, persisted state formats, message refs, or compression block IDs. Upgrading from alpha.6 requires no migration of these data.

**Known issues**

- This fix does not guarantee that local token estimates match the provider's actual request budget, nor does it resolve all performance and image-compression issues tracked in [#51](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/issues/51).

## [Version: v2.0.0-alpha.6] - 2026-11-17

Full Changelog: [v2.0.0-alpha.5...v2.0.0-alpha.6](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/compare/v2.0.0-alpha.5...v2.0.0-alpha.6)

**发布范围**

- ACP 2.0 Alpha 性能维护更新，减少请求前 token usage 估算中的重复工作。

**功能优化**

- 复用 tokenizer 实例，避免每次计数都重新初始化和释放 WASM tokenizer；保留原有文本归一化、特殊 token 处理及异常回退行为。
- 在 batch cleanup 与裁剪前统计之间共享同一消息投影的 token 计数，避免重复扫描；裁剪后的统计仍重新计算。

**兼容性与升级前置条件**

- 要求 **OpenCode >=2.1.4 且 <3**。
- 不改变配置、持久化状态格式、message refs 或 compression block IDs；从 alpha.5 升级无需进行这些数据的迁移。
- 不引入文本内容缓存，不改变历史 provider usage 的处理方式。

**已知问题**

- 本版针对 token 计数中的重复工作进行优化，不代表长历史会话的整体等待问题或图片压缩问题已全部解决，见 [#51](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/issues/51)。

---

## [Version: v2.0.0-alpha.6] - 2026-11-17

Full Changelog: [v2.0.0-alpha.5...v2.0.0-alpha.6](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/compare/v2.0.0-alpha.5...v2.0.0-alpha.6)

**Release scope**

- An ACP 2.0 Alpha performance maintenance update reducing repeated work in pre-request token usage estimation.

**Improvements**

- Reuse the tokenizer instance instead of initializing and freeing the WASM tokenizer for every count, preserving text normalization, special-token handling, and fallback behavior.
- Share the token count for the same message projection between batch cleanup and pre-pruning accounting to avoid duplicate scans. Post-pruning accounting is still recomputed.

**Compatibility and upgrade prerequisites**

- Requires **OpenCode >=2.1.4 and <3**.
- No changes to configuration, persisted state formats, message refs, or compression block IDs. Upgrading from alpha.5 requires no migration of these data.
- No text-content cache is introduced, and historical provider usage handling is unchanged.

**Known issues**

- This release targets repeated token-counting work. It does not resolve all long-history delays or image-compression issues tracked in [#51](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/issues/51).

## [Version: v2.0.0-alpha.5] - 2026-11-17

Full Changelog: [v2.0.0-alpha.4...v2.0.0-alpha.5](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/compare/v2.0.0-alpha.4...v2.0.0-alpha.5)

**发布范围**

- ACP 2.0 Alpha 维护更新，移除冗余的工具历史处理、调整 V2 集成层结构并更新 Zod 依赖。

**功能优化**

- 移除未被使用的工具参数缓存及其历史同步步骤，避免每次消息转换时执行这部分冗余工作；保留工具调用顺序记录与 token 统计。
- 将 hook handlers 迁入 `src/v2/`，集中维护 OpenCode V2 宿主集成逻辑。

**缺陷修复**

- 将 Zod 最低允许版本提高到 `4.6.6`，排除安全公告 [GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5) 涉及的受影响版本。

**兼容性与升级前置条件**

- 要求 **OpenCode >=2.1.4 且 <3**。
- 不修改公开 API、配置、持久化状态格式、message refs 或 compression block IDs。

**已知问题**

- 长历史会话的请求前等待问题仍在排查中，本版不代表整体性能问题已经解决，见 [#34](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/issues/34) 和 [#51](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/issues/51)。

---

## [Version: v2.0.0-alpha.5] - 2026-11-17

Full Changelog: [v2.0.0-alpha.4...v2.0.0-alpha.5](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/compare/v2.0.0-alpha.4...v2.0.0-alpha.5)

**Release scope**

- An ACP 2.0 Alpha maintenance update removing redundant tool-history processing, organizing the V2 integration layer, and updating Zod.

**Improvements**

- Remove the unused tool parameter cache and its history synchronization step, avoiding this redundant work during each message transform while retaining tool-call ordering and token accounting.
- Move hook handlers into `src/v2/` to keep OpenCode V2 host integration logic together.

**Fixes**

- Raise the minimum allowed Zod version to `4.6.6`, excluding versions affected by [GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5).

**Compatibility and upgrade prerequisites**

- Requires **OpenCode >=2.1.4 and <3**.
- No changes to public APIs, configuration, persisted state formats, message refs, or compression block IDs.

**Known issues**

- Pre-request delays in long-history sessions remain under investigation. This release does not resolve the overall performance issues tracked in [#34](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/issues/34) and [#51](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/issues/51).
